SYNOPSIS: On 11 February 1947 at approximately 1745 hours, 6x6 #0141, Chinese
License #41546, driven by civilian driver of A.A.G. Motor Pool Michel Martin,
pass #1119, travelling from west to east on Nanking Road stopped for a red
traffic light, behind a civilian Chrysler Sedan, Ch. Lic. #50596, driven by a
Chinese civilian Lee Chao Ziang, at the intersection with the Bund. When the
light was switched to green the civilian car, instead of moving forward,
rolled back into 6x6 #0141 and damaged its rear compartment, bumper and lamp
against the front bumper of the 6x6.

概要：1947年2月11日约17时45分，由陆军顾问团车队平民司机米歇尔·马丁（通行证 #1119）驾驶的6x6卡车（编号 #0141，中国牌照 #41546），沿南京路由西向东行驶，在外滩路口遇红灯停车，停在一辆由中国平民李兆祥驾驶的克莱斯勒轿车（中国牌照 #50596）后方。当信号灯变绿时，该民用车辆非但未向前行驶，反而向后倒退，撞入6x6卡车（编号 #0141），导致其后车厢、保险杠和车灯受损，撞击点为该卡车的的前保险杠。

pages.en:
DETAILS:
The above accident occurred on 11 February 1947, and the drivers of
both vehicles involved were taken to the Whangpoo Police Station for a report.
There were no U. S. Military Police personnel present. Both drivers were
questioned and released. Driver Martin was told that everything was alright,
and was told to proceed on his way. On arriving at the A.A.G. Motor Pool he made
a statement and filled a form 26. The man in charge of Traffic Accidents at the
above Motor Pool, being sure of the veracity of M. Martin's statement and
thinking that no claim would be filed by the owners of the Chrysler Sedan against
the U. S. Government, filed both documents away without notifying this office.

On 20 March 1947 (over a month after the accident) this office received
a letter from the Foreign Affairs Section, Shanghai Municipal Police Bureau,
dated 15 March, inclosing an estimate from the Mark L. Moody Service Station for
the cost of repairs of the Chrysler, amounting to CNC$ 732,500.00, and requesting
that the Imports Committee, Supreme Economic Administration - owners of the
damaged car - be reimbursed for the above amount.

An investigation was immediately conducted and driver Martin's written
statement was obtained from the Motor Pool. The Whangpoo Police Station was then
contacted, but no statements were available from the driver of the Chrysler, or
from C.P.C. 1872 who was on duty at the Bund/Nanking Road intersection and
allegedly witnessed the above accident as both had been questioned orally. The
investigation revealed that the Chrysler backed up into the government 6x6, and
a report was made and forwarded to the proper authorities.

On 8 April 1947 a letter from the Headquarters of the Shanghai Police
Bureau, dated April 3rd and addressed to Major F. R. Harding, was brought to the
attention of this office. The above letter contested the correctness of the
opinions stated in this office's report dated 24 March, requested that the
investigation be re-opened, and inclosed a copy of the Traffic Accident Report
made by the Whangpoo Police Station. This report showed that the Chrysler Sedan
stopped for a red traffic light and 6x6 #0141 ran into its rear, and that C.P.C.
1872 of the Whangpoo Police Station witnessed the accident.

The undersigned visited the Whangpoo Police Station once more, but was
told again that there were no written statements from either the driver of the
Chrysler or from C.P.C. 1872. The A.A.G. Motor Pool was then again contacted and
it was learnt that there was another witness to the above accident, viz.,
Maj. General Brown's civilian driver, Heinz H. Goets, pass #1103. Driver Goets
was interrogated and a written statement obtained. Driver Goets stated that at
the date and time of the accident he was waiting for Maj. Gen. Brown in a staff car
parked outside the Palace Hotel, and that he saw the civilian car roll back
against the bumper of the 6x6. Driver Goets did not see what happened after as
the General came out at that moment and they had to leave.

The undersigned next went to the Mark L. Moody Service Station and
learned from the man who examined the Chrysler and made the estimate for the cost
of repairs that all the damages mentioned were a result of a recent accident.
pages.zh:
详情：
上述事故发生于1947年2月11日，涉事两车驾驶员均被带往黄浦警察局制作笔录。当时现场无美军宪兵人员。两名驾驶员经讯问后被释放。告知马丁驾驶员一切正常，并令其继续行程。抵达陆军顾问团车队后，他作了陈述并填写了26号表格。该车队负责交通事故的人员确信M.马丁陈述的真实性，并认为克莱斯勒轿车车主不会向美国政府提出索赔，遂将两份文件归档，未通知本办公室。

1947年3月20日（事故发生一个多月后），本办公室收到上海公共租界工部局警务处外事科3月15日来信，附马克·L·穆迪服务站（Mark L. Moody Service Station）出具的克莱斯勒轿车维修费用估算单，金额为法币732,500.00元，并要求赔偿受损车辆所有人——最高经济委员会进口委员会上述金额。

随即展开调查，并从车队获取了驾驶员马丁的书面陈述。随后联系黄浦警察局，但无法获得克莱斯勒轿车驾驶员或当时在外滩/南京路路口执勤并据称目击上述事故的警员编号1872的书面陈述，因为两人仅接受了口头讯问。调查显示，是克莱斯勒轿车倒车撞上了政府6x6卡车，遂制作报告并呈送有关当局。

1947年4月8日，本办公室注意到一封来自上海警察局总部的信函，该信日期为4月3日，致F. R. 哈丁少校。上述信函对本办公室3月24日报告中所述观点的正确性提出异议，要求重新开启调查，并附上黄浦警察局制作的交通事故报告副本。该报告显示，克莱斯勒轿车因红灯停车，而6x6卡车（编号 #0141）追尾撞上其后方，且黄浦警察局警员编号1872目击了该事故。

签署人再次前往黄浦警察局，但再次被告知没有克莱斯勒轿车驾驶员或警员编号1872的书面陈述。随后再次联系陆军顾问团车队，获悉上述事故还有另一名证人，即布朗少将的平民司机海因茨·H·戈茨（Heinz H. Goets），通行证 #1103。对戈茨驾驶员进行了讯问并获取了书面陈述。戈茨驾驶员陈述称，在事故发生的时间和日期，他正驾驶公务车停在国际饭店外等候布朗少将，并看到那辆民用车辆向后倒退撞上6x6卡车的保险杠。戈茨驾驶员未看到后续发生的情况，因为将军在那一刻出来，他们不得不离开。

签署人随后前往马克·L·穆迪服务站，从检查克莱斯勒轿车并出具维修费用估算单的人员处获悉，所有提到的损坏均为近期事故所致。

pages.en:
COMMENTS & CONCLUSIONS:

The undersigned wishes to state that, contrary to the opinion stated in
the letter from the Police Headquarters to Maj. Harding, the damages to the
Chrysler could very well have occurred as a result of backing up into the 6x6,
and actually amounted to a damaged rear compartment, bumper and rear light. The
estimate from Mark L. Moody's Service Station shows that a charge of CNC$ 500,000.00
out of the total CNC$ 732,500.00 was made for repairs to the rear light.

With regard to C.P.C. 1872 witnessing the above accident, the undersigned
is of the opinion that being on duty on the Bund the C.P.C. could hardly have
witnessed the accident which occurred opposite the Palace Hotel. He probably came
to the scene of the accident after it happened and concluded that the 6x6 ran into
the back of the Chrysler and stated his opinion at the Police Station, the opinion
being entered on the Police Report as a fact.

This agent upholds his original opinion regarding the above accident,
and maintains that it was caused by the Chrysler backing into the Government 6x6.

RECOMMENDATIONS:

It is recommended that the Police Headquarters be requested to notify
the various Police Stations to inform this office of all accidents, and to hold
all persons involved untill the arrival of an agent from this office in order to
avoid all possible misunderstandings and controversies in the future.

It is also recommended that all government drivers be directed to inform
this office immediately of all accidents, no matter how trivial they may seem.

T. H. ENGLISH,
Agent, C.I.D.

Attached Documents:

A - Statement by driver Martin.
B - " " witness H. H. Goetz.
C - Copy of letter & incl. from Foreign Affairs.
D - Copy of Traffic Accident Report From Police HQ.
E - Copy of estimate from Mark L. Moody's Service St.
pages.zh:
评论与结论：

签署人谨声明，与警察局总部致哈丁少校信函中的观点相反，克莱斯勒轿车的损坏完全可能是由于倒车撞入6x6卡车所致，实际损坏包括后车厢、保险杠和后车灯。马克·L·穆迪服务站的估算单显示，在总计法币732,500.00元中，有法币500,000.00元用于后车灯的维修。

关于警员编号1872目击上述事故一事，签署人认为，鉴于该警员在外滩执勤，他很难目击发生在国际饭店对面的事故。他很可能是在事故发生后到达现场，推断是6x6卡车撞上了克莱斯勒轿车的尾部，并在警察局陈述了他的看法，该看法作为事实被记入警方报告。

本探员坚持其对上述事故的原有观点，并维持该事故是由克莱斯勒轿车倒车撞入政府6x6卡车造成的这一主张。

建议：

建议要求警察局总部通知各警察局，将所有事故通报本办公室，并在本办公室探员到达之前扣留所有涉事人员，以避免将来可能出现的所有误解和争议。

还建议指示所有政府车辆驾驶员立即向本办公室报告所有事故，无论其看起来多么微不足道。

T. H. 英格利什（T. H. ENGLISH），
刑事调查分队探员。

I, H. H. GOETZ (#1103) DRIVER OF AAG MOTOR POOL HEREBY
STATE THE FOLLOWING TRUE FACTS TO THE BEST OF MY KNOWLEDGE AND
BELIEF:

ON FEBRUARY 11TH 1947 AROUND 17.40 HOURS I WAS PARKING
WITH S/C 7523 OUTSIDE THE PALACE HOTEL WAITING FOR MAJ. GEN.
BROWN, WHEN I WITNESSED THE FOLLOWING:

A BLACK BUICK CAME AT HIGH SPEED TO THE CORNER OF BUND -
NANKING ROAD AND STOPPED BECAUSE THE TRAFFIC LIGHT CHANGED FROM
GREEN TO RED. THE FOLLOWING VEHICLE 6X6 #0141 STOPPED BEHIND
HIM AND IT WAS A DISTANCE OF ABOUT 1-1/2 TO 2 YARDS, BEHIND 6X6
PLENTY OF OTHER CARS STOPPED. AS THE TRAFFIC LIGHT CHANGED
AGAIN TO GREEN, THE PRIVATE CAR ROLLED BACK AGAINST THE BUMPER
OF THE 6X6.

I DID NOT SAY NOTHING AFTER THAT BECAUSE GENERAL CAME OUT
AND I HAD TO LEAVE. BUT I WANT TO POINT OUT THAT THE 6X6 WAS
STANDING AND THAT THE PRIVATE CAR ROLLED AGAINST THE 6X6.

/S/ HEINZ H. GOETZ

驾驶员陈述书

本人，H. H. GOETZ（编号1103），陆军顾问团汽车车队驾驶员，谨在此就本人所知所信，陈述以下事实：

1947年2月11日约17时40分，我驾驶军用车牌7523号停在华懋饭店外，等待布朗少将（Maj. Gen. Brown）期间，目睹了以下情况：

一辆黑色别克轿车高速驶至外滩与南京路转角处，因交通信号灯由绿变红而停下。随后的车辆——6x6卡车0141号——停在其后方，距离约为1.5至2码，在6x6卡车后方还停着许多其他车辆。当交通信号灯再次变为绿色时，那辆私家车向后倒车，撞上了6x6卡车的保险杠。

此后我未作声，因为将军出来了，我必须离开。但我要指出的是，当时6x6卡车是静止的，是私家车倒车撞上了6x6卡车。
